name: Spark Update
summary: SparkOS's updater: gets the new version ready in the background, tells you when a restart will start it, shows what changed and rolls back.
summary_fr: Les mises à jour de SparkOS : prépare la nouvelle version en arrière-plan, vous dit quand un redémarrage la lancera, montre ce qui a changé et revient en arrière.

optional.rpm-ostree: reading the installed versions; checking and rolling back
optional.bootc: staging new images (the system install's root timer)

needs.system: SparkOS (an rpm-ostree/bootc image). Background image downloads need the system install that ships in the image; --user gives the window, the notification and your own Flatpak updates.
